# Case 1: empty graph
{"nodes":0,"edges":{},"totalWeight":0,"partition":[]}
@ no nodes, no edges → aggregated graph is also empty
{"nodes":0,"edges":{},"totalWeight":0}

# Case 2: two nodes in one cluster
{"nodes":2,"edges":{"0":[{"to":1,"weight":1.0}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":1.0}]},"totalWeight":1.0,"partition":[0,0]}
@ single community C0 containing {0,1} → all edges become self-loop on cluster 0 (weight 2), totalWeight counts only c<d so stays 0
{"nodes":1,"edges":{"0":[{"to":0,"weight":2.0}]},"totalWeight":0}

# Case 3: three nodes split into two clusters
{"nodes":3,"edges":{"0":[{"to":1,"weight":1.0}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":1.0},{"to":2,"weight":2.0}],"2":[{"to":1,"weight":2.0}]},"totalWeight":3.0,"partition":[0,0,1]}
@ partition: 0,1 in C0; 2 in C1
@ edges:
@   0→1 (1), 1→0(1) → within C0→C0 (sum 2)
@   1→2 (2) → C0→C1 (2)
@   2→1 (2) → C1→C0 (2)
@ aggregated edges:
@   C0→C0 (2), C0→C1 (2), C1→C0 (2)
@ totalWeight sums only c<d, so only C0→C1 (2) contributes → totalWeight=2
{"nodes":2,"edges":{"0":[{"to":0,"weight":2.0},{"to":1,"weight":2.0}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":2.0}]},"totalWeight":2}

# Case 4: two disjoint clusters without inter-cluster edges
{"nodes":4,"edges":{"0":[{"to":1,"weight":1.0}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":1.0}],"2":[{"to":3,"weight":2.0}],"3":[{"to":2,"weight":2.0}]},"totalWeight":3.0,"partition":[0,0,1,1]}
@ C0: {0,1}, C1: {2,3}
@ within C0: 0→1,1→0 → C0→C0 has weight 2
@ within C1: 2→3,3→2 → C1→C1 has weight 4
@ no C0↔C1 edges; totalWeight counts only c<d (no such edges) → 0
{"nodes":2,"edges":{"0":[{"to":0,"weight":2.0}],"1":[{"to":1,"weight":4.0}]},"totalWeight":0}
